name: BeeFlix Profiles
description: Private member profiles using existing Jellyfin Enhanced reviews and ratings.

versions.changelog: PREVIEW: Adds the unified BeeFlix Community activity timeline, permanent movie and completed-series achievements, background unlock detection, and profile achievement displays. Requires compatible Plugin Pages and File Transformation. Live server testing is still needed.

PREVIEW: Adds the user-facing BeeFlix Community page, shareable member profiles, profile statistics, paginated review history, local Jellyfin title/poster resolution, and responsive honey-accent styling. Requires compatible Plugin Pages and File Transformation. Live server testing is still needed.

Adds shareable member profile links, profile-wide review statistics, newest-first paginated review history, and direct-link visibility enforcement. Preview release; test on a non-production server first.
Fixes Enhanced review-store discovery via the active plugin assembly, member visibility filtering, and profile API error reporting. Preview release; test on a non-production server first.
Fixes member visibility filtering and displays useful server errors when reviews fail to load. Preview release; test on a non-production server first.
Adds a searchable member directory with Jellyfin avatars. Preview release; test on a non-production server first.
Preview release. Test on a non-production Jellyfin server before installing on BeeFlix.
